execution: Combined coverage, not a single uninterrupted green run. Initial full run collected 129 cases and was interrupted by environment restart after 110 outcomes (108 passed, 2 failed). Focused runs covered later Studio/offline additions; the remaining 18 cases were resumed through the official --test-list filter and all passed.
baseline: The .tech-card order-technique assertion also failed at the same point on the untouched onboarding copy; retained in desktop and phone-portrait tests.
